about.features.doubleRatchet.desc: End-to-end encryption built on the Double Ratchet with X3DH and AES-256-GCM. When both devices support it, the key agreement also runs a hybrid post-quantum layer (ML-KEM-768 combined with X25519), so traffic captured today isn't readable by a future quantum computer.
about.features.doubleRatchet.title: Double Ratchet Protocol
about.features.fallback.desc: Mesh first, with no server at all. If that can't reach your contact, the message passes through our own relay, which stores it encrypted and cannot read it.
about.features.fallback.title: Hybrid Cloud Fallback
about.features.identity.desc: Your identity is a Curve25519 keypair generated on your device. Nothing to register, nothing to seize.
about.features.identity.title: Cryptographic Identity
about.features.media.desc: Send photos and videos with AES-256-GCM encryption, decrypted only by recipient.

about.features.mesh.desc: Messages relay through trusted peers to reach their destination, even offline.

about.features.ordering.desc: Advanced message buffering handles network chaos gracefully.
about.features.ordering.title: Out-of-Order Handling
about.features.qr.desc: Scan to verify and add contacts with cryptographic safety numbers.

about.features.serverless.desc: No user accounts, no phone number, no email, no data collection, no tracking.

about.footer.tagline: Built for a world without central control.
about.howItWorks.step1.desc: Create a cryptographic identity that becomes your unique, verifiable identity.
about.howItWorks.step1.title: Generate Your Identity
about.howItWorks.step2.desc: Discover nearby devices via Bluetooth or WiFi mesh, or scan QR codes to add trusted contacts.
about.howItWorks.step2.title: Connect to Peers
about.howItWorks.step3.desc: Messages are encrypted with Double Ratchet and sent directly to peers or relayed through the mesh.
about.howItWorks.step3.title: Send Encrypted Messages
about.howItWorks.step4.desc: If the mesh can't reach your contact, the encrypted message is held on our own relay server until it is delivered. The relay cannot read it, and it is never published to a public network.
about.howItWorks.step4.title: Fallback to Cloud
about.howItWorks.step5.desc: Each message gets its own key, and the chain moves forward after every send.
about.howItWorks.step5.title: Keys That Keep Moving
about.howItWorks.title: How It Works
about.openSource.paragraph1: OSHI is **100% open source**, built with transparency and auditability at its core. Every line of code is public and verifiable.
about.openSource.paragraph2: We believe that privacy tools must be open to be trusted. No backdoors, no hidden telemetry, no proprietary algorithms.
about.openSource.title: Open Source & Transparency
about.philosophy.quote1: Communication is a fundamental human right, not a product to be monetized.
about.philosophy.quote2: Privacy should be the default, not a premium feature.
about.philosophy.quote3: No one should have the power to silence your voice or read your thoughts.
about.philosophy.quote4: True freedom requires tools that cannot be controlled, censored, or surveilled.
about.philosophy.title: Philosophy
about.principles.decentralization.desc: No central authority, no single point of failure. Power distributed across the network.
about.principles.decentralization.title: Decentralization
about.principles.privacy.desc: No phone number, no email, no account, no tracking. Messages sent over the mesh leave nothing on any server at all.
about.principles.privacy.title: Privacy by Default
about.principles.resilience.desc: Works in internet blackouts, censorship, or disaster scenarios. Communication cannot be stopped.
about.principles.resilience.title: Resilience
about.principles.sovereignty.desc: You control your identity, your data, and your connections. No corporations, no surveillance.

about.vision.paragraph1: OSHI is not just a messenger — it's a **communication protocol for digital freedom**. Built on principles of sovereignty, privacy, and resilience.
about.vision.paragraph2: When someone is in range, OSHI works **with no internet and no server at all**, routing messages over **peer-to-peer mesh networking** through direct Bluetooth/Wi-Fi links or multi-hop relays. When nobody is in range, it falls back to our relay so the message still arrives.
about.vision.paragraph3: Every message is protected by the **Double Ratchet** with **X3DH** key agreement and **AES-256-GCM** — the same construction Signal uses — and it holds across offline relays and out-of-order delivery.
about.vision.title: The Vision

faq.q1.answer: OSHI is a secure, decentralized messaging app that uses mesh networking and end-to-end encryption to protect your privacy.
faq.q1.question: What is OSHI?
faq.q2.answer: OSHI uses Bluetooth and WiFi to create a peer-to-peer network with nearby devices. Messages hop between devices until they reach the recipient.
faq.q2.question: How does mesh networking work?
faq.q3.answer: Yes! OSHI uses the Double Ratchet algorithm (same as Signal) for end-to-end encryption. Only you and your recipient can read messages.
faq.q3.question: Is my data encrypted?
faq.q4.answer: Make sure to backup your keys in Settings > Backup Keys. Without your backup, you cannot recover your identity.
faq.q4.question: What if I lose my device?
faq.q5.answer: Yes! OSHI's mesh networking allows you to send messages to nearby users without internet.
faq.q5.question: Can I use OSHI without internet?
faq.q6.answer: Go to New Message and either scan your contact's QR code, share your QR code, or paste their public key.
faq.q6.question: How do I add contacts?

lora.guide.footer: Once paired, OSHI uses the node by itself: Bluetooth and Wi-Fi first for whoever is close, LoRa when nobody is. Expect a few kilometres in a city, and considerably more with height and open ground.
lora.guide.step1: Get a supported board: a Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3, a Heltec Wireless Tracker or a LILYGO T3-S3.
lora.guide.step2: On a computer, open oshi-messenger.com/lora/flash in Chrome or Edge, plug the board in by USB and flash it. It takes about a minute.
lora.guide.step3: Unplug it, switch it on and keep it near your phone.
lora.guide.step4: Tap it under Nearby nodes above. You pair it once.
lora.guide.step5: Choose the region it will be used in. Until you do, the node listens but never transmits.

onboarding_conduct_subtitle: OSHI is built on trust and respect. Please follow these guidelines:
onboarding_disclaimer_anonymous_desc: OSHI is 100% designed for total anonymity. No accounts, no phone numbers, no tracking. Your identity stays yours.
onboarding_disclaimer_audit_desc: This app has not undergone a professional security audit. While we use strong encryption, use at your own discretion.
onboarding_disclaimer_cloud_desc: When contacts are not nearby, messages are stored encrypted on our servers and voice calls go through our relay server. Message content stays end-to-end encrypted, but group names and member lists are visible to our servers.
onboarding_disclaimer_critical_desc: Designed for scenarios when a country is disconnected from the internet. Communicate freely even when networks are down.
onboarding_disclaimer_mesh_desc: Send messages and make calls with no internet, phone to phone. About 100 m directly, and further only when other people nearby have OSHI open to relay. Both phones need the app open.
onboarding_disclaimer_note: Your one-to-one messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted. No phone number or account required.
onboarding_disclaimer_notifications_desc: For security, messages and calls are only received when the app is open. In crisis situations (war, kidnapping), if your phone is locked or the app is password-protected, notifications only arrive after the app is open for 2+ seconds. Keeping the app open also lets your phone relay messages for other people nearby.

welcome.message.body:
Welcome to OSHI. Your messages are end-to-end encrypted, and you signed up without a phone number or an account — nobody was told you are here.

OSHI also works with no internet at all: nearby phones over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, and kilometres away with a LoRa radio.

Questions, or something broken? Tap below and write to me directly.
